shifts.title: Food Pantry
shifts.description: Tangibly share the love of God by providing fresh groceries to low-income households in the Tenderloin. Volunteers set up the room, run food stations, help with language interpretation and clean up.

shifts.title: The Ellis Room
shifts.description: Create space for neighbors to access resources and community. Sit and talk with neighbors, serve coffee, facilitate showers and manage donations.

shifts.title: Hot Chocolate Ministry
shifts.description: Head out onto the streets of the Tenderloin with hot chocolate. Connect with, pray for and share the Gospel with our neighbors.

shifts.title: Pop-Up Church
shifts.description: Bring church to the streets. During shelter-in-place many neighbors had no church they could reach, so now church comes to them, every Sunday morning.

shifts.title: Tenderloin Connect
shifts.description: A volunteer-led outreach into SRO buildings. Build consistent, intentional relationships with residents facing deep isolation and relational poverty.

shifts.title: Maintenance
shifts.description: Help clean, repair and improve our 100-year-old ministry center. One-day and multi-day projects all year round.
